topicName: women and the family in nazi germany

steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: The Nazi ideal for women was summed up as the "Three Ks" - Kinder, Küche, Kirche (Children, Kitchen, Church). Hitler believed that a woman's proper place was in the home, producing Aryan children and supporting her husband. He said: "The woman is the eternal companion of the man, and her world is the family." | Key Fact: In June 1933, the Law for the Encouragement of Marriage offered marriage loans of 1,000 marks to young couples if the wife gave up her job. For each child born, 25% of the loan was cancelled. If a couple had four children, the entire loan was wiped out. | Key Fact: The Nazis introduced several policies to push women out of professional employment.
